title: Now Hiring: SAP Ariba Functional Consultant (Global Digital Transformation)
description:

vVolve Management Consultants Pte Ltd, an SAP partner based in Singapore, offers tailored business solutions. We specialise in Digital Transformation, Intelligent ERP, and Cloud solutions, consistently leveraging the latest technologies to address our clients' needs. Our focus is on guiding enterprises through their Business Transformation journey by enabling Digitisation, Automation, and Business Process Improvement.

Job Description

The Mission

At vVolve Management Consultants , we don’t just implement software; we move the needle on global procurement. We are looking for a high-energy SAP Ariba Functional Consultants to navigate the intricate regulatory landscapes of diverse international markets. This isn't just about modules—it’s about building a seamless, automated, and tax-compliant supply chain on a global scale.

Your Impactful Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Strategic Design: Lead the architectural design and deployment of SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management solutions.
  • Supplier Excellence (SLP + SPM): Build robust onboarding workflows in SLP , integrated with Supplier Performance Management (SPM) to drive continuous vendor improvement.
  • Sourcing & Contract Mastery: Streamline global operations through automated sourcing events and sophisticated contract authoring and repository management.
  • Global Localisation: Adapt global templates to meet complex regional requirements, including multi-national fiscal regulations and e-invoicing mandates.
  • The Integration Bridge: Drive seamless connectivity between SAP Ariba and SAP ECC using the Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG) .
  • Strategic Liaison: Act as the primary functional expert for stakeholders across different time zones, ensuring alignment between technical builds and business needs.

Requirements

The Candidate Blueprint

We are seeking consultants who thrives in complex, multi-national environments:

  • The Experience: 6+ years consulting experience in SAP Procurement, including at least 2 full-cycle Ariba Upstream projects.
  • Module Expertise: Expert-level configuration in SLP with SPM , Sourcing , and Contracts .
  • Technical Connectivity: Deep hands-on experience with CIG / SAP Integration Suite (ECC backend).
  • The Competitive Edge: Prior experience integrating SAP Ariba with Salesforce is highly preferred.
  • Regional Agility: Proven success navigating fiscal regulations and business processes in LATAM and emerging markets.
  • Bilingual Advantage: Fluency in English is mandatory. Professional proficiency in Portuguese andFrench is a massive plus for our regional delivery teams.

Why vVolve?

? Global Scale: Manage high-visibility projects that span continents from our Singapore hub.

? Tech Leadership: Work at the forefront of Intelligent ERP and Business Technology Platform (BTP) integration.

? Entrepreneurial Culture : We value owners. If you see a way to make it better, you have the green light to lead it.

Ready to bridge the gap between global strategy and local compliance?

Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

description:
Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)

Department: Safety & Security

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security) is responsible for planning, coordinating and overseeing safety and security operations across all official non-competition sites for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes hotels, team base camps, training sites, transport hubs, the International Broadcast Centre (IBC) and other designated locations.

The role ensures that robust physical and staffed security measures are designed and implemented in line with identified risks and FIFA standards. The position leads integrated security planning for team and referee operations outside stadium environments and oversees secure movements between official sites. The Manager provides direct leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and relevant Venue Safety & Security Managers assigned to non-competition locations, ensuring consistency, compliance and operational excellence across all sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the integrated safety and security planning for all official non-competition sites, including hotels, team base camps, training facilities, transport hubs, the IBC and other designated locations
  • Develop scalable security concepts tailored to diverse site types and operational risk profiles, including transport security considerations
  • Plan and oversee robust physical security systems and infrastructure, including perimeters, access control, asset protection, search and screening operations
  • Plan and oversee staffed safety and security measures, including security guards, stewards and other deployed personnel
  • Lead the planning and implementation of team and referee security protocols at non-competition sites, including oversight of secure movements between sites and stadiums
  • Provide direct line management and leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and designated Venue Safety & Security Managers, ensuring clear reporting lines and operational accountability
  • Coordinate centrally with host cities, public security agencies and site counterparts to ensure integrated planning and consistent operational delivery
  • Collaborate with relevant domestic agencies and FIFA functions (e.g. medical, venue management, transport) to develop integrated emergency response, contingency and crisis management plans
  • Develop and implement standardised policies and procedures to ensure consistent safety and security operations across all non-competition sites
  • Ensure alignment between safety and security services outlined in rental or contractual agreements and the operational delivery model; establish clear audit and performance monitoring mechanisms
  • Manage relationships with security suppliers, conduct readiness activities and monitor performance against contractual obligations and service levels
  • Oversee invoicing and verification processes for safety and security suppliers in coordination with finance and administrative teams
  • Ensure compliance with statutory and organisational instruments and relevant FIFA regulations, including the FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations (where applicable)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in security management, public safety, event management, law enforcement or a related field
  • Advanced training in protective security, risk management or operational planning is desirable

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security planning and operational delivery, preferably within major sporting events or multi-site environments
  • Proven experience in leading teams and managing personnel in operational environments
  • Demonstrated experience in secure movement planning, team protection or protective security operations
  • Experience working with public security authorities, private security providers and venue operators in Brazil
  • Experience managing supplier contracts and monitoring service delivery

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and line management capability, with the ability to guide, motivate and oversee multiple operational managers
  • Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills across diverse site environments
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage complex, dynamic operational environments and make decisions under pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including structured reporting
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

O(a) Recepcionista será o primeiro ponto de contato dos pacientes e famílias na clínica, sendo responsável por proporcionar uma experiência acolhedora, organizada e humanizada desde o momento da chegada até o término do atendimento. Essa pessoa atuará em um ambiente com grande fluxo de pacientes e atendimentos por diversos planos de saúde, e terá papel essencial na organização do fluxo de agendamentos e documentação da clínica.

  • Receber e acolher pacientes e acompanhantes, oferecendo atendimento cordial e empático;
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de dados no sistema da clínica, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas;
  • Fazer agendamentos, remarcações e confirmações de consultas por telefone, WhatsApp e presencialmente;
  • Orientar sobre documentação, autorizações e guias necessárias para os atendimentos;
  • Conferir guias e autorizações de planos de saúde, encaminhando-as corretamente para o setor de faturamento;
  • Organizar e controlar a agenda dos profissionais, mantendo a comunicação clara entre pacientes e equipe técnica;
  • Apoiar na rotina administrativa da recepção, como controle de presença, emissão de recibos e arquivamento de documentos;
  • Manter o ambiente da recepção organizado e acolhedor, refletindo os valores de cuidado e profissionalismo da clínica.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Fisioterapia ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em recepção de clínica ou hospital, preferencialmente com atendimento a convênios de saúde;
  • Vivência com grande volume de atendimentos e rotina dinâmica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão clínica ou prontuário eletrônico;
  • Domínio básico do pacote Office (principalmente Excel e Outlook);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional e empática;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo precisão no preenchimento e conferência de guias;
  • Comprometimento com sigilo e ética profissional, respeitando as informações dos pacientes e os protocolos internos.

Sobre a Empresa

A Equitar Therapies é uma clínica de neurodesenvolvimento infantil com sede no Rio de Janeiro, dedicada ao atendimento de pessoas com deficiência ou necessidades especiais, com o objetivo de promover autonomia, qualidade de vida e socialização. Com mais de 40 anos de atuação, a empresa iniciou sua história como consultoria especializada na implementação de programas de hipoterapia em universidades e centros de saúde. Desde 1997, mantém uma sólida parceria com o Jockey Club Brasileiro e, atualmente, está presente em diversas unidades — entre elas, Lagoa, Sociedade Hípica Brasileira e Jacarepaguá. A clínica conta com uma equipe interdisciplinar altamente qualificada, formada por profissionais de áreas como Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiologia, Terapia Ocupacional, Psicologia, Psicopedagogia e Equoterapia. Todos atuam de forma integrada, com foco em um atendimento humanizado, técnico e ético.

  • Implantar e manter procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs), instruções de trabalho e registros de qualidade.

  • Ensino superior completo (Tecnologia/Têxtil/Engenharia ou similar). Desejável curso técnico em Metrologia ou Técnico Têxtil.
  • Experiência em qualidade têxtil com tecido plano e Lycra; conhecimento em costura e acabamento.
  • Conhecimento prático de normas ISO de qualidade e boas práticas de produção.
  • Experiência com controle estatístico de processo (SPC) e ferramentas de qualidade (5S, PDCA, 8D).
  • Conhecimento em etiquetagem têxtil e requisitos regulamentares legais.
  • Experiência em inspeção de matéria‑prima e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Domínio do pacote Office; experiência com Linx ou ERP similar.
  • Perfil: comunicação clara, liderança, orientação a resultados e controle de processos.

Deseja:

  • Inglês intermediário; experiência em marcas de moda/resortwear de luxo.
  • Vivência com testes laboratoriais têxteis (pilling, ensaios de resistência, elasticidade).

São Cristóvão - 100% presencial

title: Principal Genesys Cloud PS Consultant
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands-on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys-related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect.
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features.
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce.

Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: General Manager, International Athletics
description:
Our Mission

International athletes face an uphill battle when trying to recruit to top US universities. The process is opaque, confusing, and stacked against those without access to specialized guidance. Crimson Education changed the game for international students applying to elite universities—we've helped thousands reach Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, Cambridge, and beyond. We're now doing the same for international student‑athletes. Over the past decade, we've built International Athletics into a global business serving athletes across 25+ countries. After years of steady growth, we've recently hit our stride—our service delivery is excellent and results are strong. Now we need someone to take the reins and scale aggressively.

The Opportunity

As General Manager, you'll run International Athletics like the CEO of your own company—but with the resources and safety net of a larger organization. You won't be grinding for every lead like a pure startup, but you will need to build our marketing presence, enable sales teams globally as well as close deals yourself, and drive strong growth.

What You'll Do

Own the Unit End-to-End

  • Set strategy, make decisions, and own revenue outcomes
  • Work closely with our Head of Marketing (Athletics) to build campaigns and accelerate growth
  • Oversee a small team of strategists who deliver service to student‑athletes
  • Partner with country managers across 25+ markets to scale sales

Drive Revenue Growth

  • Enable local sales teams globally to sell Athletics packages effectively
  • Lead athletics sales consultations where your recruiting experience is the credibility driver
  • Build our Instagram, website, and marketing presence
  • Identify expansion opportunities through partnerships, new markets, or service improvements

Manage Service & Team

  • Ensure consistently excellent outcomes for student‑athletes
  • Manage full‑time and part‑time strategists
  • Recruit and build the team as we scale, with support from our recruitment team
  • Work with other product GMs at Crimson who are navigating similar challenges

Navigate the Matrix

  • Coordinate with local sales and marketing teams who primarily sell Crimson's core services
  • Build trust and alignment across a global, remote organization
  • Prove ROI and earn resources through strong performance

Required

  • You recruited as an international athlete to a top US or UK university.
  • Strong sales or business development skills—you've closed deals and hit targets
  • Self‑directed and entrepreneurial—you figure things out and drive outcomes
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and moving quickly
  • Genuinely excited about helping international student‑athletes
  • Comfortable working remotely (we're a global, distributed team)

Preferred

  • Experience managing teams or working in matrix organizations
  • Current or recent role in athletics recruiting, coaching, or advising
  • Track record at a high‑growth company or startup
  • Located in a timezone that allows calls with Asia, Australia, and North America

title: Online Pre-IGCSE Science
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Must be available to teach 1 or 2 hours per week on a Wednesday 1pm - 6pm AEST (Brisbane timezone).

Job Summary

Join our global team as an online teacher for Pre-IGCSE Science and immerse yourself in a premium one-on-one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver Pre- IGCSE Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

Must be available to teach in the Australian/ New Zealand timezone, we have a lot of demand for this space so hours can be flexible.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalized, high-quality instruction in a one-on-one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of teaching at this level in a school setting.
  • Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement.
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching.
  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A-Levels curricula and examinations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license
  • Online teaching experience

About Crimson Global Academy

CGA is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We are doing this by:

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students’ perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting-edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education.

If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now!

To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.

Reports / Administrative Activities

Participation in FAT Tests

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.

Who You Are

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.

For this role, you will need

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands‑on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high‑pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.

Our Culture and Commitment to You

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well‑being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people‑focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos muito felizes por saber que você se interessou em embarcar em uma grande jornada aqui no Grupo EP, e para isso é muito importante que conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

  • Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade, atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
  • Estamos entre as5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país, com50 anosde existência .
  • Visamos o cuidado e respeito ao meio ambiente, com isso tivemos mais de660 milhões de m³ de efluentes tratados por nossos clientes até hoje (o equivalente ao consumo de água da população do estado de SP, 12 milhões de pessoas, durante um ano).
  • Nosso maior objetivo é a expansão da nossa organização, em 2033 nossa meta é expandir nossa atuação no Brasile com isso contamos um time de500 colaboradores divididos nas 5 frentes de atuação da EP.

Temos quatro valores que regem nossos direcionamentos e atuação na EP, que são:

  • Paixão por aprender: Aqui valorizamos, incentivamos e investimos pesado em educação. Somos uma empresa que presta serviço, ou seja, vendemos o conhecimento do nosso time e por isso oferecemos diversas maneiras para que você tenha acesso aos melhores cursos e se desenvolvam profissionalmente.
  • Falo e faço :É o valor que garante um ambiente íntegro e coerente entre o discurso e as ações. Transparência e honestidade são essenciais em qualquer relação dentro e fora da EP, com colaboradores, clientes, fornecedores e comunidade.
  • Visto a camisa: Para termos sucesso no mercado e qualidade em cada serviço que fornecemos, valorizamos que nossos colaboradores estejam alinhados com nosso propósito e que possam exercer suas funções em sua totalidade e com segurança.
  • Hoje melhor que ontem: Acreditamos que se todos buscarem fazer hoje algo melhor do que fizeram ontem, visando melhoria contínua, seremos uma empresa melhor a cada dia também. Para nós qualidade é nosso combustível que nos mantém ativos.

Se você, assim como nós, também é movido à água e quer fazer a diferença no mundo. Vem com a gente!

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

title: User Operations Intern
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a User Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support day‑to‑day user service and quality efforts that directly improve ride safety, platform trust, and user retention across millions of trips; your work will drive measurable reductions in issue resolution time and increase user satisfaction scores. You will join the User Operations team, which focuses on resolving rider and driver concerns, enforcing policy, and optimizing operational workflows to protect user experience and enable scalable, reliable service delivery.

In this role, you'll be...

  • User Segmentation Analysis: Assist in segmenting users based on multi‑dimensional data (e.g., New, Active, Churned) and identifying behavioral patterns and pain points.
  • Execution of Messaging Strategies: Responsible for the configuration and execution of in‑app messages, pop‑ups, H5 and out‑of‑app communication tasks such as push, WhatsApp/SMS, email.
  • Copywriting & Localization: Craft compelling marketing copy for different user segments and optimize localized content to boost Click‑Through Rates (CTR).
  • A/B Testing Support: Assist in conducting A/B tests for copy and strategies, tracking data performance, and providing insights for future optimization.
  • Tool Management: Operate internal CMS and automated marketing platforms to ensure precise and timely delivery of messages across all user touchpoints.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Educational Background: Current undergraduate student, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or Statistics.
  • Logic & Copywriting: Excellent writing skills with the ability to capture user psychology; strong logical thinking and a basic understanding of user segmentation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal) for crafting marketing copy; proficiency in Chinese is a plus.

title: User Operations Intern
description:
About the Company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the Team / Role

As a User Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support day‑to‑day user service and quality efforts that directly improve ride safety, platform trust, and user retention across millions of trips; your work will drive measurable reductions in issue resolution time and increase user satisfaction scores. You will join the User Operations team, which focuses on resolving rider and driver concerns, enforcing policy, and optimizing operational workflows to protect user experience and enable scalable, reliable service delivery.

In this role, you'll be...

  • User Segmentation Analysis: Assist in segmenting users based on multi‑dimensional data (e.g., New, Active, Churned) and identifying behavioral patterns and pain points.
  • Execution of Messaging Strategies: Responsible for the configuration and execution of in‑app (In‑app messages, Pop‑ups, H5) and out‑of‑app (Push, WhatsApp/SMS, Email) communication tasks.
  • Copywriting & Localization: Craft compelling marketing copy for different user segments and optimize localized content to boost Click‑Through Rates (CTR).
  • A/B Testing Support: Assist in conducting A/B tests for copy and strategies, tracking data performance, and providing insights for future optimization.
  • Tool Management: Operate internal CMS and automated marketing platforms to ensure precise and timely delivery of messages across all user touchpoints.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Educational Background: Current undergraduate student, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or Statistics.
  • Logic & Copywriting: Excellent writing skills with the ability to capture user psychology; strong logical thinking and a basic understanding of user segmentation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal) for crafting marketing copy; Proficiency in Chinese is a plus.
  • Data Sensitivity: A basic understanding of operational metrics (e.g., CTR, Retention) and proficiency in Excel are required. Proficiency in SQL queries is a plus.
  • Work Ethic: Highly detail‑oriented and responsible. Since messaging tasks impact the entire user base, a high level of accuracy is required.

You’ll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Treasury Analyst, you’ll be an integral part of Carta’s Fund Administration business supporting a global FA Treasury team—owning daily operational processes while driving improvements that enhance the overall client experience. Beyond executing payments and managing bank administration tasks, you’ll collaborate cross‑functionally to identify inefficiencies, contribute to scalable solutions, and help shape how we support fund operations at scale.

  • Own end‑to‑end payment execution workflows, including initiating and reviewing ACH / Wire and FX payments for client approval
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams such as Product, Engineering and Operations to troubleshoot issues, improve processes, and influence product roadmaps
  • Communicate with clients and external stakeholders to address inquiries and provide a high‑quality support experience
  • Lead or support the opening and setup of new client bank accounts in partnership with Onboarding and Implementation teams
  • Establish and maintain bank connectivity, ensuring transactions are accurately uploaded to the Carta platform
  • Proactively identify operational gaps, risks and support the development of scalable solutions
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of internal reporting, documentation, playbooks, and training resources
  • Support data analysis and reporting needs using Excel, Metabase, Looker and other internal data tools

The Impact You’ll Have

At Carta, we’re building infrastructure that helps innovators unlock the power of ownership. On the Treasury team, you'll be at the center of that mission—ensuring our clients’ capital flows reliably and efficiently. You'll work closely with the Fund Administration team to help with the day‑to‑day payment processing requests and bank administration tasks on behalf of fund administration clients. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring accurate and timely fund movements for our clients. Your contributions will help improve and scale our Treasury processes, while giving you the opportunity to grow cross‑functionally and influence how we support fund operations at Carta.

About You

  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written

  • Proficient in Excel and adaptable to learning tools like Looker, Salesforce, or other internal platforms

  • Intellectual curiosity with a strong appetite for continuous learning and growth
  • Strong problem‑solving and critical thinking skills; naturally curious and solution‑oriented
  • Interested in building a long‑term career in Treasury, Fund Administration, or fintech operations
  • Understanding of Fund Administration is a plus

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Oficial Eletricista
description:
Descrição do cargo

Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de instalações, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do contrato; executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos (aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, back lights, postes de iluminação, boilers, bombas hidráulicas, tele tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc.), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra‑estrutura do contrato; executar a manutenção preventiva de quadros elétricos de baixa tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica por aparelho multiteste, limpando componentes com produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra‑estrutura do contrato; realizar operações em linhas de alta tensão em caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do contrato; executar a manutenção preventiva de no-break, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas; executar a manutenção preventiva de subestações, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra‑estrutura do contrato; operar subestações em caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do contrato; efetuar a manutenção preventiva de transformadores, reapertando e lubrificando peças; efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos; emitir formulário específico (laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à chefia; efetuar anotações em livro de ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção; atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade; orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimir dúvidas e indicar procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.

title: Engenheiro (a) de Confiabilidade e Manutenção Pl.
description:
Overview

Somos a Brava Energia, a Companhia independente de óleo e gás mais diversificada do Brasil. Temos operações em terra e mar, do upstream ao downstream, com mais de mil colaboradores em nossa força de trabalho. Oferecemos amplas oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira, em um ambiente dinâmico, focado em resultados e alta performance. Estamos constantemente aplicando a experiência do nosso time para maximizar nossa produção, transformando O&G em valor para o Brasil.

Missão do cargo: Atuar como responsável técnico pela implementação, sustentação e evolução das práticas de Engenharia de Confiabilidade, promovendo o aumento da disponibilidade operacional, redução de falhas recorrentes e melhoria contínua da qualidade dos dados de manutenção. O profissional deverá estruturar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), garantir a governança técnica do banco de dados do CMMS (IBM Maximo) e suportar decisões estratégicas por meio de análises orientadas a dados, contribuindo diretamente para a confiabilidade dos ativos offshore.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar metodologias de Engenharia de Confiabilidade, baseadas na análise de dados históricos, criticidade de ativos e padrões corporativos, assegurando a adequada aplicação das melhores práticas ao longo do ciclo de vida dos ativos.
  • Estruturar, calcular e monitorar KPIs de confiabilidade e manutenção, incluindo indicadores técnicos de desempenho dos ativos e indicadores de qualidade dos dados, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e suporte efetivo à gestão.
  • Conduzir análises de falhas e degradação, utilizando metodologias como RCA, FMEA/FMECA, análise de tendências e modelagem estatística (ex.: Weibull, quando aplicável), propondo ações corretivas e preventivas estruturadas.
  • Realizar análises de desempenho operacional, com foco no aumento da disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos ativos e na redução do custo do ciclo de vida, apoiando decisões técnicas e econômicas.
  • Atuar como guardião técnico do banco de dados de manutenção no CMMS (IBM Maximo), promovendo a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos registros, da confiabilidade das informações e do uso efetivo dos dados.
  • Elaborar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais de confiabilidade, integrando análises técnicas e visão executiva, para suporte à tomada de decisão em diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Definir, padronizar e acompanhar a codificação de falhas, modos e causas de falha, garantindo consistência dos registros e robustez das análises futuras de confiabilidade.
  • Suportar tecnicamente as áreas de planejamento, operação e manutenção, na definição de estratégias e planos baseados em criticidade de ativos, histórico de falhas e desempenho operacional.
  • Participar da definição, revisão e padronização de processos corporativos relacionados à Engenharia de Confiabilidade e à Gestão de Ativos, assegurando alinhamento com diretrizes internas e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Identificar lacunas de competência técnica e promover a disseminação de boas práticas de confiabilidade, análise de falhas e qualidade de dados, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento contínuo da organização.

Formação

Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, Materiais, Petróleo, Produção/Industrial ou áreas afins.

Conhecimentos | Habilidades | Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, incluindo RCA, FMEA/FMECA, Análise de Criticidade, RCM e estudos de custo–risco–benefício.
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas (ASME, ANSI, ISO, normas brasileiras) e regulamentações aplicáveis da ANP (SGSO, RTSGI, SGSS, RTDT, NR-13, entre outras).

description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha crescer com a Cardway

Na Cardway, acreditamos que conexões bem construídas movem negócios e transformam trajetórias.

Somos uma empresa de meios de pagamento movida por pessoas, tecnologia e relacionamento, em um ambiente onde você pode aprender, se desenvolver e ver o impacto do seu trabalho no crescimento da companhia e dos nossos parceiros.

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento, e quer fazer parte de um time que constrói resultados juntos, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

Sobre a Cardway

A Cardway é uma empresa brasileira de meios de pagamento e soluções digitais, formada a partir da união entre o Grupocard e a Movilway, duas referências no mercado que somam décadas de expertise e inovação no setor.

Atuamos com um portfólio completo e integrado de soluções que reúne meios de pagamento, telecom, serviços digitais, mobilidade urbana, serviços bancários e a plataforma CardHub, conectando tudo em um único ecossistema para nossos parceiros.

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Nossa cultura é guiada por valores que orientam nossas decisões:

  • Compromisso com Parceiros e Clientes
  • Transparência
  • Excelência na Prática
  • Colaboração
  • Responsabilidade

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem quando as pessoas se sentem parte e trabalham juntas em um ambiente ético, colaborativo e bem estruturado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Consultor de Vendas , você terá um papel fundamental na construção de relacionamento com nossos clientes e parceiros, ajudando a levar nossas soluções a cada ponto de venda.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atrair, conquistar e encantar clientes, criando conexões que gerem valor e relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Apresentar produtos com precisão, destacando diferenciais, preços e condições, além de orientar sobre o pós-venda.
  • Realizar comparativos de preços e benefícios, facilitando a decisão de compra com clareza e confiança.
  • Negociar com clientes externos, elaborar propostas comerciais, fechar vendas e ampliar a carteira de parceiros.
  • Garantir o abastecimento dos pontos de venda, oferecendo suporte contínuo e acompanhando a performance dos produtos.
  • Manter o padrão visual da marca com instalação e manutenção de materiais de merchandising.
  • Atualizar cadastros e controlar o estoque com atenção e responsabilidade.

Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro/ RJ

Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e construir relacionamentos de confiança com nossos parceiros.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • CNH válida (categoria B)
  • Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para atuação em campo
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos na região de atuação

Competência e habilidades:

  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para se relacionar com diferentes perfis de pessoas
  • Organização e autonomia para planejar sua rotina e visitas
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade
  • Interesse em aprender e se desenvolver na área Comercial

Ainda, você terá acesso à Uniway, nossa plataforma de educação corporativa, com cursos e treinamentos para apoiar seu crescimento.

Diversidade importa (e muito!)

Esta vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

Processo seletivo seguro e transparente

A Cardway não realiza qualquer tipo de cobrança, solicitação de curso pago ou taxa em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo. Todas as comunicações oficiais são feitas exclusivamente por canais da empresa.

title: Sales Representative - Brazil
description:
Sales Representative - Brazil (100% Remote)

Do you want to dive in the fast-growing industry of drones and get a rewarding experience in a dynamic scale-up environment?

At Flyability, we believe that robots should be sent into hazardous places and dangerous situations instead of humans. To support our belief, we created Elios, the world’s first collision-tolerant flying robot that for the first time allows remote entry to complex and indoor spaces. With more than 100 employees, Flyability is the pioneer in the UAV indoor inspection industry. Joining Flyability is not just taking on a new job, it is seizing the opportunity to improve the life of millions of people and build the future of robotics.

Location: Must be based in Rio de Janeiro

Starting date: as soon as possible

Your role:

We are looking for a Sales Representative to join our Sales team. In this role, you will be reporting to the Managing Director for the Americas, based at the company headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland.

On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with new customers to identify product fit and close deals. You will collaborate with our distribution partners in your area to ensure that opportunities are progressing and that they are receiving the support they need from us. You will also frequently meet with accounts in your territory to ensure their satisfaction and help them scale their use of our technology.

This role will own all commercial activities for Brazil. We are therefore looking for someone who can work independently and proactively, build and grow relationships with customers and partners, and quickly learn the needs of various industries to identify and deliver added value.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the sales objectives and growth strategy in your assigned territory
  • Build and maintain leads and opportunities pipelines for direct and indirect sales
  • Travel to industrial sites across South America (with a strong emphasis on Brazil) for meetings, demonstrations, or proof of concepts. Work on industrial sites may include operating the drone in-asset, which could imply working at heights or in hazardous environments
  • Build relationships with local key accounts with periodic discussions and ensure they scale to their full potential
  • Manage and develop a network of channel partners
  • Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound campaigns and events in coordination with the marketing team
  • Assist in organizing and executing multiple trade shows and roadshows
  • Assist with various sales projects, support or logistical issues as needed

Your profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher and/or equivalent experience required
  • At least 3 years of sales experience in industrial products or related complex commercial product sales
  • Ability to communicate proficiently in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a strong-added asset
  • Experience with direct B2B sales
  • Excellent written, verbal and public speaking skills
  • Proven track record of selling large contracts to companies or government agencies
  • Ability to load, unload, set up equipment weighing 50–70 pounds
  • Ability to work on industrial sites, which may require climbing multiple flights of stairs
  • Ability to work in Brazil and drive a vehicle
  • Ability to travel up to 70% of the time, nationally and internationally
  • Ability to quickly learn needs and processes in various industries
  • Proactivity, integrity, and the ability to work in an international team
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Experience in hardware and software sales (B2B) is a plus
  • Experience with UAVs, ROVs or other robotics solutions is a plus

Flyability is a young Swiss company that values independent thinking combined with a collaborative spirit. Every day, you will have the opportunity to share your ideas and contribute to solving problems. We all work together, and each voice is important to move forward

Ready to join?

We know the confidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply - regardless of your experience or resume, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive based salary and commission structure
  • Uncapped commission scheme for over-performance
  • Annual trip to Switzerland
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment
  • Phone allowance

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. BuscamosFisioterapeutas Visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Porporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos, desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequadas e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e programar as ordens de serviço de manutenção eletromecânica, considerando manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, conforme criticidade dos ativos.
  • Dimensionar horas de manutenção (HH), avaliando capacidade da equipe e reservando margem para atendimentos corretivos.
  • Verificar e assegurar a disponibilidade de recursos necessários à execução das ordens de serviço (mão de obra, materiais, ferramentas e terceiros).
  • Controlar prazos, escopos e execução das atividades, garantindo aderência ao planejamento técnico.
  • Monitorar indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, backlog, cumprimento de planos e custos por OS).
  • Analisar falhas recorrentes e históricos de manutenção, propondo melhorias nos planos e processos.
  • Elaborar relatórios analíticos para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Atuar como interface entre manutenção, operação, engenharia e suprimentos.
  • Apoiar auditorias por meio da organização e controle da documentação técnica e histórico de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em planejamento e controle de manutenção.
  • Experiência com gestão de ordens de serviço, backlog e priorização de atividades.
  • Conhecimento de Excel avançado e ferramentas de planejamento (Project).
  • Experiência com sistemas de manutenção, preferencialmente SAP.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e dinâmico, com boa capacidade de comunicação.

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

As a Treasury Analyst, you’ll be an integral part of Carta’s Fund Administration business supporting a global FA Treasury team—owning daily operational processes while driving improvements that enhance the overall client experience. Beyond executing payments and managing bank administration tasks, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally to identify inefficiencies, contribute to scalable solutions, and help shape how we support fund operations at scale.

  • Own end-to-end payment execution workflows, including initiating and reviewing ACH / Wire and FX payments for client approval
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering and Operations to troubleshoot issues, improve processes, and influence product roadmaps
  • Communicate with clients and external stakeholders to address inquiries and provide a high-quality support experience
  • Lead or support the opening and setup of new client bank accounts in partnership with Onboarding and Implementation teams
  • Establish and maintain bank connectivity, ensuring transactions are accurately uploaded to the Carta platform
  • Proactively identify operational gaps, risks and support the development of scalable solutions
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of internal reporting, documentation, playbooks, and training resources
  • Support data analysis and reporting needs using Excel, Metabase, Looker and other internal data tools
  • Verify vendor / payee wire instructions, collect necessary documentation (e.g., W-9s), and ensure compliance with internal controls

The Impact You'll Have

At Carta, we’re building infrastructure that helps innovators unlock the power of ownership. On the Treasury team, you'll be at the center of that mission—ensuring our clients' capital flows reliably and efficiently. You'll work closely with the Fund Administration team to help with the day-to-day payment processing requests and bank administration tasks on behalf of fund administration clients. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring accurate and timely fund movements for our clients. Your contributions will help improve and scale our Treasury processes, while giving you the opportunity to grow cross-functionally and influence how we support fund operations at Carta.

About You

  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written
  • 2–3 years of experience in Treasury, banking operations, or payment processing, with an interest in growing into more strategic or technical roles
  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of ownership over assigned workflows
  • Clear verbal and written communicator who is comfortable interacting directly with clients and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Proficient in Excel and adaptable to learning tools like Looker, Salesforce, or other internal platforms
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking thoughtful questions, and proposing ideas for process improvement
  • Intellectual curiosity with a strong appetite for continuous learning and growth
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; naturally curious and solution-oriented
  • Interested in building a long-term career in Treasury, Fund Administration, or fintech operations
  • Understanding of Fund Administration is a plus

Experiência prévia como Product Manager, Product Owner ou função equivalente, participando da construção de produtos digitais do discovery ao lançamento .

Vivência com produtos que utilizam Inteligência Artificial , especialmente GenAI , como assistentes, agentes, automações, copilots internos ou sistemas de recomendação.

Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em hipóteses de produto , fluxos de usuário, requisitos funcionais e métricas claras de sucesso.

Capacidade de utilizar dados para tomada de decisão , com experiência em ferramentas de analytics, métricas de produto ou exploração de dados (ex.: noções de SQL).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis , com ciclos rápidos de experimentação como MVPs, POCs e testes A/B .

Experiência criando protótipos com ferramentas de no/low-code ou AI coding tools (ex.: Replit, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini Apps).

Atuação em projetos de automação de processos internos com IA (operações, CS, marketing, RH, financeiro, etc.).

Vivência em times de inovação, AI Labs ou produtos em early stage , com alto nível de experimentação.

Escopo de atuação

Identificar e priorizar casos de uso de IA com impacto real no negócio , como ganho de eficiência operacional, aumento de receita ou melhoria de experiência do usuário.

Conduzir discovery com usuários e áreas de negócio , utilizando entrevistas, mapeamento de jornadas e análise de dados para entender problemas e oportunidades.

Definir objetivos, métricas e critérios de sucesso para cada iniciativa de produto baseada em IA.

Prototipar e validar rapidamente novos conceitos de produto utilizando ferramentas de prototipação, no/low-code ou colaboração direta com times técnicos.

Apoiar a definição de boas práticas de uso responsável de IA , considerando governança, privacidade, segurança e mitigação de vieses.

Documentar decisões de produto, hipóteses, experimentos e aprendizados , promovendo compartilhamento de conhecimento entre times.
