description:
Who we are

At Fortis Games we aspire to make great games that bring people together while redefining how game companies work. We believe in building a sense of belonging through our games, their communities, and how we operate and treat each other. Through our game communities, we will create powerful connections and lasting memories. We will foster a culture of diversity, equity and belonging where together our diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds impact the games we make.

About the Role

As a Staff Technical Artist at Fortis Games, you will take a leading role in shaping the technical foundations of our art pipelines across multiple projects. You’ll independently design and implement complex solutions, introduce new processes that drive creative and technical work forward, and partner with senior leaders across art, design, and engineering to ensure seamless collaboration.

This role goes beyond supporting production—it’s about building scalable systems, leading senior ICs, and facilitating cross‑functional communication so that our teams can deliver innovative, high‑quality experiences efficiently. You will serve as both a technical leader and mentor, helping Fortis push the boundaries of art and technology in mobile gaming.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Architect and oversee scalable art pipelines across multiple projects, ensuring consistency, technical efficiency, and creative flexibility.
  • Design and implement new tools and processes that accelerate iteration, improve workflow efficiency, and enhance collaboration between art, design, and engineering teams.
  • Introduce and evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., procedural systems, AI‑assisted pipelines, real‑time rendering) to keep Fortis at the forefront of technical innovation.
  • Mentor senior ICs , translating strategy into actionable tasks and fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Facilitate cross‑functional communication , aligning art, engineering, and production workflows to keep goals clear and achievable.

title: Senior
description:
Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

The Opportunity:

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join theInvestments Business Unit.

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become anAI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

  • Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

  • Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

  • Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

  • Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

  • Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

  • Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

  • Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

  • Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

  • AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

  • Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

  • Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

  • Manage the complete Smart Resources Request process, ensuring accurate and timely resource booking.
  • Monitor and coordinate all requests through the AMER MB South Resources shared mailbox.
  • Track and update service planned dates, ensuring schedule accuracy in the Kanban board and internal tools.
  • Update and maintain the Billable Rate report and other operational planning data.
  • Follow up on service demand and scheduling information using CRM/Salesforce, ensuring information is correct and up to date.
  • Validate service requests from Sales Proposals, confirming feasibility, technical requirements, and alignment with resource capacity.
  • Coordinate with operations and Field Service Engineers to confirm availability, resolve planning constraints, and address schedule changes.

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. 1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced engineering leader to join our team and lead the development of software solutions with both front-end and back-end components. Your team will be responsible for delivering products that support internal operations and drive our market-facing initiatives. You’ll be part of an international environment, working closely with cross-functional teams to shape and evolve our platform and digital experiences. We value teamwork and embrace a culture of ownership—our engineers are both autonomous and accountable for their deliverables. We are deeply customer-focused and committed to building software that creates real value for our users and the business.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development support.
  • Own the architecture and development of full-stack applications using React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers to translate requirements into actionable development tasks.
  • Oversee CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth deployments and high system reliability.
  • Design and implement scalable backend services leveraging AWS services.
  • Drive best practices in coding standards, code reviews, and system architecture.
  • Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure on-time delivery.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Engineer or similar role, with at least 2 years in a team lead or management capacity.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (DocumentDB, Lambda, EKS, API Gateway, S3, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and working with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
  • A strong advocate for clean code, tests, scalability, and performance optimization.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

title: Sales Representative - Brazil
description:
Do you want to dive in the fast-growing industry of drones and get a rewarding experience in a dynamic scale-up environment?

At Flyability, we believe that robots should be sent into hazardous places and dangerous situations instead of humans. To support our belief, we created Elios, the world's first collision-tolerant flying robot that for the first time allows remote entry to complex and indoor spaces. With more than 100 employees, Flyability is the pioneer in the UAV indoor inspection industry. Joining Flyability is not just taking on a new job, it is seizing the opportunity to improve the life of millions of people and build the future of robotics.

To complete our creative and dynamic team, we are seeking a:

Sales Representative - Brazil (100% Remote)
Location: Must be based in Rio de Janeiro
Starting date: as soon as possible

Your role

We are looking for a Sales Representative to join our Sales team. In this role, you will be reporting to the Managing Director for the Americas, based at the company headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland.

On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with new customers to identify product fit and close deals. You will collaborate with our distribution partners in your area to ensure that opportunities are progressing and that they are receiving the support they need from us. You will also frequently meet with accounts in your territory to ensure their satisfaction and help them scale their use of our technology.

This role will own all commercial activities for Brazil. We are therefore looking for someone who can work independently and proactively, build and grow relationships with customers and partners, and quickly learn the needs of various industries to identify and deliver added value.

What you will own

  • Own the sales objectives and growth strategy in your assigned territory
  • Build and maintain leads and opportunities pipelines for direct and indirect sales
  • Travel to industrial sites across South America (with a strong emphasis on Brazil) for meetings, demonstrations, or proof of concepts. Work on industrial sites may include operating the drone in-asset, which could imply working at heights or in hazardous environments
  • Build relationships with local key accounts with periodic discussions and ensure they scale to their full potential
  • Manage and develop a network of channel partners
  • Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound campaigns and events in coordination with the marketing team
  • Assist in organizing and executing multiple trade shows and roadshows
  • Assist with various sales projects, support or logistical issues as needed

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher and/or equivalent experience required
  • At least 3 years of sales experience in industrial products or related complex commercial product sales
  • Ability to communicate proficiently in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a strong-added asset
  • Experience with direct B2B sales
  • Excellent written, verbal and public speaking skills
  • Proven track record of selling large contracts to companies or government agencies
  • Ability to load, unload, set up equipment weighing 50-70 pounds
  • Ability to work on industrial sites, which may require climbing multiple flights of stairs
  • Ability to work in the Brazil and drive a vehicle
  • Ability to travel up to 70% of the time, nationally and internationally
  • Ability to quickly learn needs and processes in various industries
  • Proactivity, integrity, and the ability to work in an international team
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Experience in hardware and software sales (B2B) is a plus
  • Experience with UAVs, ROVs or other robotics solutions is a plus

Your profile

  • Bachelor's degree or higher and/or equivalent experience required

Ready to join?

We know the confidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don't hesitate to apply - regardless of your experience or resume, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive based salary and commission structure
  • Uncapped commission scheme for over-performance
  • Annual trip to Switzerland
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment
  • Phone allowance

title: Launch Program Manager, Emerging Countries Engineering Services
description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer‑centric company on earth. To get there, the Global Engineering Services Launch (Launch) team needs exceptionally talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. The key to this mission is strategic, large scale project management initiatives that will allow us to scale our organization for the future in an extraordinary manner.

The Launch team is seeking a qualified candidate to solve the complex challenges of progressive innovation to drive efficiencies at operational benchmark rates. We are looking for a customer‑obsessed Program Manager with proven program management experience and a strong track record of delivering results to own and execute highly strategic launches, in addition to driving multiple complex projects across one or more programs. If you are looking for an environment where you can drive business innovation amidst various levels of ambiguity, this is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing team within Amazon!

Key Responsibilities

  • Gains trust and consistently delivers results;
  • Is results driven, hard‑working, and a creative person who loves solving challenging problems;
  • Works backwards from the customer to scope and define program requirements and critical milestones;
  • Can effectively navigate ambiguous situations without heavily relying on direct support from their leader;
  • Is able to demonstrate a high level of ownership to drive multiple time‑sensitive action items simultaneously through multiple business groups;
  • Is able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines whilst maintaining a customer focus;
  • Is comfortable collaborating and influencing team members, working with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis;
  • Has the ability to partner to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year;
  • Optimizes cross‑team processes that improve team efficacy and delivery;
  • Has the technical aptitude to quickly grasp complex technical issues and communicate directly with technical teams;
  • Takes ownership and accountability for programs, while maintaining the ability to ask for help, and escalates issues and problems as necessary to keep programs on track;
  • Is comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and operating in a rapidly evolving and changing landscape;
  • Is willing to drive into the details and leverage high judgment and gut instinct;
  • Communicates effectively to all stakeholders related to a launch or program/project.
  • Extensive travel, up to 50%.

A Day in the Life

  • Effectively managing the Road to Launch process, which ultimately allows for a building hand‑off that passes operational readiness testing and sets the operations team up for success;
  • Managing day‑to‑day relationships with multiple Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Sort Centers (SCs), and Delivery Stations (AMZL);
  • Coordinating GES and Operations stakeholders to exceed Amazon standards for the launch of new sites or expansions of existing buildings in order to achieve operational success;
  • Deep diving existing processes to identify defects or opportunities for process improvements;
  • Compiling, managing, and reporting on weekly project metrics;
  • Driving multiple projects to optimize, standardize, and/or improve processes within and outside of launch.

About The Team

Have you ever had an opportunity to be a member of a team that is tasked with solving a huge customer need through disruptive, innovative technology, reinventing an industry? You can expect all the challenges and benefits of a high‑profile business: wide‑open space for process improvement and innovation, and a high caliber, high performance team, within a fast‑paced environment. This role will require a willingness to dive deep into the details, proactively solve problems, leverage thorough judgment and intuitive thinking to strategically grow a program and always obsess over customers. Everyone on the team wears multiple hats, however ownership of the customer experience is always prioritized!

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in program or project management;
  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements;
  • Experience in driving end‑to‑end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership;
  • Fluent Portuguese and English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in driving process improvements;
  • Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field;
  • Fluent in French, Polish, Arabic, Spanish, Chinese, Turkish, Afrikaans or Zulu.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Statistician — Time-Series Insights Writer (AI Training)
description:
We’re seeking Statisticians with strong English writing skills to join our Deep Research for Forecasting project. In this role, you will review time-series plots (a quantity of interest over time) along with brief contextual descriptions, then identify the most meaningful patterns in the data and produce concise, well-reasoned causal chains explaining what likely drove those patterns.

Your work will help create high-quality tasks used to train and evaluate AI systems on forecasting-related reasoning. You will focus on distinguishing signal from noise, articulating plausible mechanisms (root cause → intermediate drivers → observed time-series impact), and writing explanations that are clear, grounded, and useful for downstream model training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create Forecasting Training Tasks: Given a time-series plot and short description, identify the most important patterns (trend, seasonality, regime changes, outliers, step changes, cyclical behavior, variance shifts) and document them clearly.
  • Write Causal Chains: Produce concise causal narratives that explain patterns from root cause → mechanism → observable time-series effect, prioritizing the most meaningful drivers and avoiding generic explanations.
  • Ensure Clarity & Usefulness for AI Training: Write structured, high-signal explanations that are easy to evaluate, minimizing ambiguity and making assumptions explicit when necessary.
  • Maintain Consistency & Quality: Follow project guidelines and rubrics to ensure outputs are accurate, coherent, and comparable across many examples.
  • Weekly Commitment: 10 hours/week

Your Profile

  • You have an educational and/or professional background in Statistics or a closely related field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science).
  • Proficient in time-series analysis and forecasting (e.g., trend/seasonality, structural breaks, anomalies, volatility shifts, lag effects).
  • Excellent English writing skills with a clear, structured, concise style.
  • Strong analytical judgment and ability to interpret data visualizations with precision.
  • Comfortable forming plausible causal explanations while clearly separating evidence from assumptions.
  • Optional: Domain knowledge in one or more of the following: Healthcare; Climate/oceanography; Economics & finance; Cloud operations; Transportation.

Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.
  • Working closely with the Senior Manager, Recruitment & HR & HRBP’s to:
  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all-staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament-time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament-time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end-to-end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiners first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 5 years’ experience in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Ability to provide examples where excellent client service skills and the capacity to facilitate the needs of multiple business units has served you well in your career to date.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Fluent Portuguese, advanced or fluent English skills (written & spoken)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Reliability & Rotating Equipment Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocatio[...]
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a reliability/rotating equipment engineer to join the North Ghawar Maintenance Division (NGMD) / Reliability Unit (RU) of the North Ghawar Producing Department (NGPD).

The RU's scope includes condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis to identify and mitigate potential equipment failures. By leveraging these services, the RU aims to optimize rotating equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and improve overall asset efficiency.

Your primary role is to provide proactive maintenance support, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, and overseeing rotating equipment overhaul activities to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimize downtime.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Oversee and perform Product Data Management (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, to identify potential equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and implement condition-based maintenance programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Develop and implement reliability-centered maintenance programs to identify and prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment reliability and criticality.
  • Perform failure analysis on equipment to identify root causes of failures and recommend corrective actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Perform technical evaluations of new equipment to ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, and to identify potential reliability and maintenance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, such as American Petroleum Institute (API), American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), and American Society for Testing and Materials ASTM, for rotating equipment and reliability engineering.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including management and operations teams.
  • Perform oil analysis and other predictive maintenance tests to identify potential equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Perform diagnostics on rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, and gearboxes, to identify potential problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain Reliability Unit KPIs such as maintenance cost reduction, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR).

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have a minimum of 15 years of experience in reliability/rotating equipment engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of reliability, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, and condition-based maintenance.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment diagnostics such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Hold a vibration analyst certificate Cat‑III.
  • Understand industry standards and codes related to reliability, such as API, ASME, and ASTM.
  • Practical experience in reliability engineering or a related field, preferably in the oil and gas industry.
  • Effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness of the latest advancements in reliability science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Experience with Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis.
  • Familiarity with condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Ability to perform and aid in technical evaluations of new equipment.

title: Senior Structural Engineer
description:
Job Overview

Senior Structural Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Structural (Eng) discipline within McDermott. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience and shares conceptual and practical expertise related to the Structural (Eng) discipline. Solves complex problems and uses discipline‑specific knowledge to improve products or services. Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities with the Structural (Eng) team and other related teams and ensures work is within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Responsibilities

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, studies, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct engineering team as a Lead Engineer on small projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short‑term work activities in own area
  • Clearly communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Train/mentor Engineers
  • Assist MOPEX offices on projects
  • Have a good understanding of the other engineering departments
  • Initiate interface with other disciplines to obtain input for discipline designs
  • Provide engineering support as required
  • Perform engineering checks of drafting
  • Perform engineering checks prepared by others within the discipline
  • Perform design verification through single‑discipline check and assist with inter‑discipline checks (IDC)
  • Prepare MTOs of structures
  • Prepare specifications
  • Prepare subcontract documents
  • Review vendor data
  • Prepare technical bid evaluations
  • Check designs for operational requirements, constructability, and maintainability
  • Tasks as Engineering Specialist
    • Perform independent computer analyses of structures
    • Prepare details and layouts of structures
    • Prepare structural analyses and reports on calculations or perform specialist tasks (e.g. architectural designs, underground piping designs, complex structures, topsides, jackets, weight control reports, center of gravity reports)
    • Specialized in several fields (geotechnical, steel, concrete, dynamic calculations, FEM, fatigue calculations, earthquake, jackets, FPSOs, blast, hydrodynamics, architectural, etc.)
    • Specialized in some design codes (EC, ACI/AISC/API, GOST, etc.)
    • Prepare project engineering guides
    • Coordinate and check the work of engineers and designers
  • Tasks as Lead Engineer

VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

Garantir o funcionamento eficiente e contínuo dos sistemas de refrigeração e climatização por meio da execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas, assegurando o conforto térmico e a integridade dos equipamentos, alinhado às normas de segurança e sustentabilidade.

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas e equipamentos de refrigeração, climatização, ventilação e calefação.

  • Realizar testes operacionais nos equipamentos após manutenção ou instalação para garantir sua eficiência.

  • Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos ambientais durante as atividades de manutenção.
  • Acompanhar fornecedores externos em processos de instalação e manutenção de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização.

  • Realizar a triagem e avaliação inicial do paciente, com os familiares e cuidadores, anotando os dados na ficha de triagem e anexá‑la ao prontuário;
  • Realizar psicodiagnóstico de cada paciente e desenvolver o plano terapêutico de acordo com sua necessidade bem como acompanhar‑lo em sua execução;
  • Disponibilizar atendimento psicológico ao paciente e realizar intervenções com objetivo de auxiliar o paciente na adesão ao tratamento e minimizar o sofrimento provocado pela hospitalização e pelo adoecimento;

  • Contactar paciente e/ou familiares em circunstância de alta para manter vínculo com a instituição;
  • Contactar, por telefone, familiares de pacientes que evoluíram a óbito, com o objetivo de oferecer suporte e acolhimento ao processo de luto;
  • Realizar atendimento aos familiares em processo de luto, anotando em um formulário a evolução do caso;
  • Participar, semanalmente, de reunião com a equipe multidisciplinar para discussão de casos dos pacientes;
  • Intervir, quando necessário, nas decisões com relação à conduta a ser adotada pela equipe multidisciplinar, para oferecer maior apoio, equilíbrio e proteção aos pacientes e familiares;
  • Participar das reuniões agendadas com os familiares e, quando necessário, fazer apontamentos e sugestões que promovam melhorias no cuidado ao paciente;
  • Realizar grupos específicos de acordo com a necessidade, para colaboradores, cuidadores e familiares com a aplicação de terapias grupais ao público;
  • Realizar e organizar, em conjunto com o setor de Terapia Ocupacional, os eventos de datas comemorativas;
  • Recepcionar e acompanhar celebrantes que realizam cultos religiosos para os pacientes/familiares e equipe;
  • Fazer relatório mensal da evolução do paciente para o convênio, bem como arquivar as evoluções no prontuário;

description:
A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.

MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS

Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL). É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina.

A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós clicando aqui.

Sobre a Posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de TI Sênior com forte visão funcional e técnica, capaz de atuar como protagonista na conexão entre áreas de negócio e fornecedores de tecnologia. Esse profissional terá papel estratégico na definição de soluções, transformando necessidades dos usuários em entregas tecnológicas assertivas, escaláveis e de alta qualidade. Na posição, você será responsável por apoiar decisões de arquitetura, participar ativamente na evolução das plataformas corporativas e contribuir para o sucesso dos projetos executados com fornecedores parceiros. Buscamos alguém com excelente capacidade de comunicação, domínio técnico para dialogar com desenvolvedores e visão analítica para apoiar o negócio com clareza e precisão. Se você gosta de desafios, deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborar diretamente para a melhoria contínua de sistemas críticos, essa oportunidade é para você.

Como Será Seu Dia a Dia

  • Realizar o desdobramento dos requisitos funcionais em documentação técnica clara e completa.
  • Atuar lado a lado com desenvolvedores de API (Java) e SalesForce, propondo soluções de arquitetura orientadas à escalabilidade, resiliência e performance.
  • Discutir arquitetura de solução com áreas cross (Arquitetura, Segurança da Informação, Dados e Infraestrutura).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento executado por fornecedores, garantindo aderência às especificações e aos requisitos não funcionais.
  • Questionar e orientar arquiteturas de software, propondo melhorias quando necessário.
  • Participar de diagnósticos de falhas, consultando dados nos diversos bancos de dados (postgres, sqlserver, Oracle), engajar os times necessários e conduzir análises de causa raiz.
  • Apoiar a evolução da plataforma e propor correções ou melhorias contínuas.
  • Aprofundar-se no conhecimento funcional dos sistemas sob sua responsabilidade para atuar como referência nas fases de QA interno e UAT.
  • Auxiliar usuários no diagnóstico de falhas em produção, suporte a incidentes e problemas.
  • Atuar como líder técnico nos projetos, servindo como referência para o planejamento junto com o gerente do projeto e os fornecedores.

Do Que Você Precisa

  • Experiência sólida em análise funcional e técnica.
  • Bagagem técnica em desenvolvimento, especialmente para atuar com APIs em Java, avaliando soluções e discutindo detalhes técnicos com desenvolvedores.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de arquitetura de software (escalabilidade, resiliência, performance, observabilidade, segurança).
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e processos associados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramenta de gestão de trabalho (Jira).
  • Experiência em projetos que envolvem múltiplos fornecedores e áreas internas.
  • Vivência com troubleshooting, análise de incidentes e identificação de causa raiz.
  • Inglês fluente para conversação (participação em reuniões, apresentações e alinhamentos técnicos).
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Perfil crítico, organizado e orientado a soluções.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de negociação.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders.

Buscamos alguém que tenha experiência em...

  • Conhecimento comprovado na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Domínio de práticas e padrões de integração (APIs REST, mensageria, microsserviços).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Conhecimentos em UML, BPMN e boas práticas de documentação técnica.

Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x2). Essa posição será baseada no Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Quem somos

A Incentive.me é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas a vendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Quem procuramos

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Dados com perfil analítico e consultivo, capaz de transformar dados em insights acionáveis e em histórias claras e relevantes para clientes.

Essa pessoa terá papel central na leitura de resultados de campanhas, construção de análises em BI e desenvolvimento de materiais visuais que apoiem decisões, mostrem valor e aumentem o engajamento dos clientes com a estratégia da Incentive.me. Mais do que “operar dados”, queremos alguém que saiba interpretar contexto, identificar padrões, gerar recomendações e comunicar bem. Possibilidade de crescimento para coordenador se atender às expectativas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar bases de dados de campanhas e programas de incentivo para identificar padrões, oportunidades, desvios e alavancas de resultado.
  • Transformar dados em insights claros e acionáveis, com foco em performance comercial e comportamento da força de vendas.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards e visuais em ferramentas de BI (Power BI).
  • Interpretar indicadores e métricas de negócio (ex.: adesão, engajamento, performance, conversão, CAV, ROP, etc.) e traduzir isso em recomendações práticas.
  • Criar narrativas analíticas (“data storytelling”) para apresentações, relatórios executivos e reuniões com clientes.
  • Apoiar times internos (atendimento, community, operação e estratégia) com análises que direcionem decisões e priorizações.
  • Garantir consistência e qualidade das análises, validando dados e sinalizando possíveis inconsistências.
  • Estruturar relatórios recorrentes e análises para acompanhamento de campanhas.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes quando necessário, ajudando a explicar resultados e responder dúvidas com segurança analítica.
  • Documentar principais métricas, premissas e leituras para dar escala e consistência às análises.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com análise de dados aplicada a negócio (BI, performance, marketing, comercial ou áreas correlatas).
  • Domínio de SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade de construir dashboards claros, objetivos e visualmente organizados.
  • Boa capacidade de interpretação de métricas e leitura crítica de resultados.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa interação com times multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com campanhas de incentivo, trade marketing, varejo ou força de vendas.
  • Conhecimento em Python para análises complementares e automações.
  • Vivência com apresentação de resultados para clientes ou áreas de negócio.
  • Noções de estatística aplicada e testes simples (comparativos, tendências, coortes etc.).

  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;

title: Especialista em Segurança da Informação
description:
Estamos buscando um Especialista em Segurança da Informação que será responsável por atuar como a principal referência técnica e estratégica da área de Segurança da Informação, liderando a concepção, implementação e evolução do programa de segurança. O profissional será responsável por pesquisar, desenhar e orientar a implementação de soluções de ponta para proteger a organização contra ameaças cibernéticas avançadas, com foco especial em segurança para Inteligência Artificial, proteção de dados, resposta a incidentes e elevação da cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderança Técnica: Ser o ponto focal para discussões de arquitetura de segurança, orientando a equipe e as áreas de negócio na adoção de tecnologias e processos seguros.
  • Estratégia de Segurança de Dados: Desenvolver e liderar a implementação de um programa de proteção de dados, incluindo classificação da informação, Prevenção de Perda de Dados (DLP), criptografia e gerenciamento de direitos digitais.
  • Segurança em Inovação (IA/ML): Avaliar os riscos e definir os controles de segurança para projetos que utilizem Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, garantindo que a inovação ocorra de forma segura.
  • Resposta a Incidentes: Atuar como líder técnico na resposta a incidentes de segurança complexos, coordenando as ações de contenção, erradicação e recuperação, e conduzindo a análise de causa raiz.
  • Threat Intelligence e Threat Hunting: Liderar iniciativas de caça a ameaças (Threat Hunting) e consumir inteligência de ameaças (Threat Intelligence) para antecipar e mitigar ataques direcionados.
  • Cultura de Segurança (Awareness): Arquitetar e sustentar um programa de conscientização em segurança que seja relevante e eficaz, utilizando métricas para demonstrar a sua evolução.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Visão Holística de Segurança: Profundo conhecimento em múltiplas áreas, como Segurança de Redes, Segurança em Nuvem (AWS, Azure), Segurança de Endpoints (EDR/XDR), Gestão de Identidade e Acesso, e Segurança de Aplicações.
  • Frameworks de Mercado: Domínio de frameworks como NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001/27002 e MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Legislação e Conformidade: Conhecimento sólido em leis de proteção de dados (LGPD) e outros regulamentos do setor.
  • Liderança e Comunicação: Habilidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para diferentes públicos (técnico, executivo) e de influenciar decisões estratégicas.
  • Certificações (Diferencial): Certificações de prestígio como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ou especializações GIAC (GCFA, GCIH) são altamente desejáveis.

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;

  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Auxilio Farmácia;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.
